status: experimental captured-runtime report mapping; not a registered AIREP profile
source: Exact captured-v1 JSON bytes. Identity is captured at emission, including the actual starting LangGraph checkpoint ID. Terminal checkpoint is separately recorded. No identity supplied by a consumer query is injected into a source report.
clock: Same-machine monotonic nanoseconds, relative to a capture-session origin, under an explicitly accepted session clock ID. No comparison across clock IDs or process restart is established. Replay arrival ticks describe deterministic transport scheduling, not measured network latency.
receipt: receiver_observed requires byte-exact command decoding and identity equality. It supports RECEIVED only.
execution: native_interrupt_observed requires matching interrupt payload and nonempty terminal checkpoint/next; handler_ignored supports CONTINUED only. Neither supplies an effect observation.
effect: Two captured effects.jsonl byte snapshots with ordered read intervals. Identical snapshots support QUIESCENT within the sampled window only; an exact prefix with appended well-formed business-step rows supports CONTINUED. Changed, removed, or malformed history is rejected. Two reads cannot exclude transient changes between samples.
binding: Existing Core and Authenticated verification of a signed Decision test report binds exact captured source bytes, projected event bytes and this basis digest. Signature proves no source truth. Consumer policy remains separate from native lifecycle verdicts.
limits: Controlled same-host author-side capture and offline delivery replay, not independent enforcement evidence.
QUIESCENT_REPORTED means identical sampled bytes in the exact window, not continuous or permanent stopping.
Starting checkpoint is an actual InMemorySaver checkpoint; no durable restart/resume is tested.
Native verifier results remain unchanged; signed Decisions are mapping reports, not new Control/Execution/Effect artifacts.
